discovery.evidence: Live official Colima state congress legal library congresocol.gob.mx (Leyes section, server-rendered rows with DOC and PDF download links per document) fetched 2026-11-14; index sha256 dff58d629df83f2ba2ca452adcc8013882ae9d2d69d6868b1075ee78c66a086a. Classes enumerated via POST /web/www/leyes/plantilla_datos.php (site own listing endpoint, wildcard lc=%): Constitucion 1, Codigos 6, Leyes Estatales 154, Reglamentos 8 = 169 catalogued documents; each document offers a Word file and a PDF twin, PDF preferred as canonical (2 entries have broken catalog links in every encoding tested: Ley de Casas de Empeno, one untitled Reglamento row - documented as catalog-link-broken, not retried further). Leyes Municipales class deferred (annual fiscal ordinances, out of current scope); Estatutos and Abrogados classes excluded by class. Full HEAD sweep of all 169 canonical PDFs on 2026-11-14: 167x HTTP 200, 0 over 10MB. Batch 6/17: col-ley-051, col-ley-052, col-ley-053, col-ley-054, col-ley-055, col-ley-056, col-ley-057, col-ley-058, col-ley-059, col-ley-060.

rightsReview.basis: Bounded acquisition of official state legislative texts under the same documented basis as the closed programs: LFDA art. 14 frac. VIII (documented basis, not a legal conclusion). Verified 2026-11-14 before acquisition: robots.txt absent (404; absence of robots is NOT treated as permission by itself); no AI-agent or content-signal restrictions observed; no aviso legal, terms-of-use or reuse/IP prohibition located on the congress site (absence of terms is NOT treated as express authorization by the owner); official state congress library publishing direct document downloads (Word + PDF twins, public catalog listing endpoint used by the site own pages); no blocks with default user agent. Scope limited to official normative texts (constitucion, codigos, leyes, reglamentos); quarantine only; no publication, no product activation. Stop the source if any restriction or challenge appears.
